summary: OpenText filed an 8-K announcing a Rule 144A/Reg S offering of senior secured notes and, in parallel, a tender offer for up to $450 million principal of its outstanding 3.875% Senior Notes due 2028, subject to increase or decrease. The exchange offer-style liability management is financing-conditioned and tied to redeeming the 2027 notes; Global Bondholder Services is tender and information agent. The Offer to Purchase is dated September 23, 2026. Watch tender participation, pricing of the new secured notes, and whether proration or upsizing affects the capital structure overhang.
